finding.statement: Both raters stated that the ~2019 architecture document contained little useful information for the task of clustering the build targets, so they did not use it much to inform their mappings; they relied mainly on reading/skimming the up-to-date source code.
finding.interpretation: The ledger is empty NOT because the documented intent matched the code, but because the document does not describe the system at the granularity of build targets / projects — it was bypassed as an input. The R6 'measured staleness' instrument (doc-vs-code deltas) therefore returns 'not measurable at this granularity', which is itself the staleness result to report: the project's only architecture write-up is too old and too coarse to seed a target-level reference, and the reference is a code-derived expert consensus (GT-exp) rather than a doc transcription.
finding.consequence_for_grade: GT-exp confirmed (not GT-doc); the 'documented intent' leg of the companion-plan §5 step 2 protocol did not contribute.
